{{Quote|The Republic is not to be trusted. They make noises about peaceful resolutions, but only once their army is amassed a short hyperspace jump away. We can feel the weight of those soldiers and their weapons behind every creaky promise the Republic chooses to insult us with.|Spokesbeing Alto Stratus, repeating his often-heard rhetoric in the Caucus Chambers|<ref name="HNN 14:7:02" />}}
The '''Caucus Chambers''' was a location on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]] that served as the seat of the [[Jabiim Congress]]. At one point, a [[Jabiimi]]te [[Spokesbeing]] [[Alto Stratus]] made a speech to the [[Jabiim Congress]] that rebuffed appeals from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the last-hour negotiations spearheaded by the [[Alderaanian Diplomatic Corps/Legends|Alderaanian Diplomatic Corps]] in the Caucus Chambers. The speech was later recorded in a [[HoloNet News Core Edition]] report on the situation on [[Handooine/Legends|Handooine]] and Jabiim.<ref name="HNN 14:7:02" />
